# HexPiece 2.9.6

The Light fruit, reworked after Kizaru at Egghead (I went through 29 GIFs of his Egghead fight with Luffy for reference). Nothing here
has been tested in game yet; the build's checks and tests pass, and I rendered and checked every new effect.

- **Z: you become light.** Hold Z and your body turns into a beam of light that shoots where you look, about 60 blocks a second. It
  reflects off everything it hits: every block at any angle, and the water (aim at the sea and it bounces you back up). Mobs and
  players on the way get hit, and the light keeps going through them. Let go (or after 3 seconds) and you're a body again where the
  light is, still moving with some of its speed, so a bounce off the water throws you up into the sky. A quick tap still goes a short
  way. Same 3 uses as before, each coming back after 4 seconds.
- **How it looks and sounds:** a white-hot ball of light with Egghead's four-pointed star on it and rings of light bursting off behind,
  trailing a gold ribbon that bends wherever it reflected. Each reflection leaves a ring of light on the wall, floor or water, with a
  glass "ping". While you're light you hear a beam hum that fades the moment you reform. In first person your hands are gone and
  streaks of light rush past. Both new sounds are CC0 recordings from Freesound ("Weapons Beam Loop" by unfa, "UI Hover Glass Ping"
  by Qvantor).
- **No more teleport snaps.** The sprinting kick (sprint + left click), the fall from the air (left click looking down) and the
  speed-of-light kick (V) used to jump you there in one frame. Now you travel there as light over a few ticks (it follows the target if
  it moves), then the kick or the explosion lands as you arrive. The speed-of-light kick still comes from behind their left shoulder
  and spins into the side of the head.
- **Egghead's star of light** now shines on the fingertip when the laser fires, on the light gathering for the beam, on Yasakani's
  crossed hands and on every hit flash.
- What changed for the old Z: it used to jump you along its path in one frame, stopping beside the first mob. Now you travel the
  path as light, as long as you hold Z.
- Still not answered from before: how 2.9.5's Conqueror charge and release sound, and how 2.9.4's Haki (sparks in your Ryou colour,
  Gear 5's lightning, the fissures, bodies thrown back) plays.
